# Vibe Roulette

> One click, one startup idea to build. The idea generator for vibe coders.

Vibe Roulette combines 100+ real niches (dog groomers, local plumbers, wedding
planners…) with 80+ shippable product types (booking tools, AI voice agents,
Chrome extensions…) into 9,000+ concrete build prompts. Free, no login.

- Home: https://viberoulette.lol/
- Browse ideas by niche and product: https://viberoulette.lol/ideas/
- Sitemap: https://viberoulette.lol/sitemap.xml

## How it works

1. Click SPIN.
2. Get a niche + a product type (+ optional twist), e.g. "An AI voice agent for local plumbers."
3. Start building tonight.

## Facts

- Free forever. No ads, no affiliate links, no email capture, no tracking.
- Analytics: cookieless, EU-hosted (Vemetric).
- Stack: single static page + serverless stats proxy.
